source_locator: 17 U.S.C. § 107, statutory text only (heading and footnote excluded)
review_notes: Fresh selected-passage pilot from the U.S. Copyright Office statutory text. Codex reviewed every operative assertion in the frozen § 107 passage. Illustrative purposes and reproduction modes are examples within the fair-use rule, not independent guarantees of fair use. The four listed considerations are nonexclusive ("shall include"). Unpublished status alone does not bar a finding, provided all listed factors are considered. Codex labels are not independent human review or held-out evidence. The excerpt contains no section heading in the input text, so extractor-visible source_unit is DOCUMENT; the original source locator is stored above as provenance.
instruction: Extract the legal rules and required considerations in this selected statutory passage, preserving negation, examples, and conditions.

gold.subject: fair use of a copyrighted work
gold.evidence: the fair use of a copyrighted work, including such use by reproduction in copies or phonorecords or by any other means specified by that section, for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching (including multiple copies for classroom use), scholarship, or research, is not an infringement of copyright

gold.subject: fair-use determination

gold.subject: fair-use determination
